title: Civic Line 24 px pixel fits for the 37 topic and atlas drawings, for drawings board C
status: Proposed. For approval by name on drawings board C (DR-205); not in use until Dustin approves.

rules.screens: The pillar icons' switch (DR-179, D2-808): on 1x screens a 24 px topic or atlas symbol draws its fit; from 2x it draws its Civic Line master.
rules.edition: One color, the black edition only (D2-1132). On Charcoal the sprite sets the ink to Newsprint, as it does for the masters.
rules.sizes: Use each fit at 24 px only.
rules.line: One pixel, as the approved pillar fit B (DR-179).
rules.growth: Each drawing grows toward 22 px across, 1.01 to 1.39 times its master's extent at 24 px, and sits centered on the box (the pillar fits' D2-613).
